messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "doctor or dermatologist"
set: ["doctor or dermatologist", "consult doctor or pharmacist about safety", "doctor", "tell doctor if have or had bipolar disorder or mania", "inform doctor or laboratory staff of use", "call doctor for hypoglycemia or diabetic ketoacidosis", "tell any doctor or lab before tests", "tell doctor if have or had pregnancy", "inform doctor when starting or stopping antibiotic", "inform doctor about new or changing skin growth or non-healing sore", "call doctor for little or no urination", "inform doctor or pharmacist if pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding", "tell doctor if have or had stroke or high blood pressure", "inform doctor when starting or stopping heart or blood pressure medication", "tell doctor if feel faint or unwell with vomiting or diarrhea", "tell doctor if have or had liver problems"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
